instrument: Board of Zoning Appeals denial, 300 Jones Road data center appeal (Aug 25, 2026)
summary: The board unanimously denied the appeal of LightHouse Data Centers (Lightstone Group) for a 200,000 sq ft, 60 MW data center on a former paper-mill site; staff treated the June rejection as final, so any resubmission is a new application.
notes: The final moratorium (Sept 21) exempts sub-65 MW data centers on former industrial sites that do not self-generate, subject to spacing and development-agreement conditions.
